messages:
Marco Diaz: Quick check — planning a per-customer VIP flag flip for Enterprise customer NOVA tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Goal: enable VIP routing + larger token quota for NOVA's VIP seats (contracted). Canaries: 5% user sessions, then 25%, then 100%. Need: allowlist provisioning, contract gating confirmation, and a quick code review of the gating logic PR.
Priya Patel: @Marco noted. Which flag key are we using? Is this a tenant-scoped flag or account-level entitlement? :eyes:
Marco Diaz: tenant-scoped. flag key: `tenant_feature.nova_vip_access`
Marco Diaz: canary config (draft):
```
canary:
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 25
      duration: 1h
    - pct: 100
      duration: 30m
allowlist: ["vip-seat-ids"]
```
Alex Chen: Ops question — do we already have NOVA's VIP seat IDs in the allowlist service? If not, need a ticket to staging ops to provision. I can run the apply once ops confirms.
Jen Ortiz: Product confirms NOVA contract includes VIP routing and higher rate limits. Legal already signed amendment (ref: CONTR-784). No extra approvals needed other than standard SOC checks.
Priya Patel: I reviewed PR #3421 briefly — gating looks good but we should add an explicit fallback: if allowlist service times out, default to non-VIP route (fail-safe). Also add metrics: `feature.flag.eval`, `flag.allowlist.latency`, and `vip.route.rate`.
Marco Diaz: Good call. I'll add the fallback and metrics. @Alex can you run the canary playbook once rollout-bot gives the green?
Alex Chen: Yep. Ping me when allowlist is populated. I can run the orchestration: `tools/rollout canary --flag tenant_feature.nova_vip_access --steps 5,25,100 --notify #eng-platform`
OpsBot: [auto] Allowlist query for NOVA returned 0 entries. Run `./ops/allowlist create --customer NOVA --ids <csv>` to provision.
Marco Diaz: Ops, please add these seat ids: vip-13,vip-14,vip-42. I put them in the shared sheet.
rollout-bot: [auto] Canary playbook set for 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z. Requires: allowlist non-empty, PR #3421 merged, SLOs green.
Priya Patel: Small ops checklist: 1) provision allowlist 2) merge PR 3) add fallback metrics 4) sanity queries against canary 5) rollback plan documented. Anyone want to own rollback docs?
Alex Chen: I'll own rollback docs and the immediate kill-switch steps. Will put runbook in the ticket.
Marco Diaz: Thanks all — I'll drop a final preflight message 30m before start and link PR + runbook. :thumbsup:
